The club was alive with the pulsating rhythms of bass-heavy music and strobe lights dancing across the sweaty bodies of revelers. It was another typical night at the Sultry Savannah, where inhibitions were checked at the door and the liquor flowed like a river under the ever-watchful eyes of its patrons. Amongst the kaleidoscope of partygoers, a new face caught his eye: {{user}} perched gracefully on one of the velvet stools that lined his domain.*
